capturedBinary.description: Release configuration built for the iOS Simulator from the same source commit with the eas.json production profile environment; ad-hoc simulator signature. Not the signed App Store IPA.
capturedBinary.otaUpdates: EXUpdatesCheckOnLaunch=NEVER (embedded bundle of this commit only)

capture.route: GitHub Actions macos-26 runner: iOS Simulator, Release build (appstore-shots-sim-capture.yml, branch capture/appstore-sim-build-195)
capture.statusBar: cropped from every frame; the caption band replaces it

sampleData.loadedVia: the app's own Welcome > Restore from a backup flow (Files picker); no app code changed
sampleData.merchants: all fictional; no third-party logos (build 195 shows letter monograms only)

capture.tour: .maestro/appstore-195/{1-light,2-dark,3-light}.yaml at that commit; appearance set with simctl ui between passes
capture.simulatorTimeZone: UTC (runner default); ledger dates generated for 2026-11-26

presentation.method: capture-195/presentation/index.html + frames.json rendered by headless Chrome at exactly 1206x2622, then re-encoded as opaque RGB PNG (scripts/e2e/png-rgb.mjs stripAlpha). Native pixels are scaled uniformly; nothing redrawn.

notes: Simulator capture, not the paired iPhone 16 Pro named in appstore-recapture.md; the simulator route was chosen by the capture brief and confirmed by the owner on 26 Nov 2026 (no phone was used).

Frame 5 uses Bills > Card payments rather than the Accounts tab, and frame 7 uses a savings goal rather than category budgets, because build 195 wraps the $ sign above the amount in account and budget rows (raw/alt-05-accounts-light.png, raw/alt-07-budgets-light.png).
Frame 7 is savings, not automatic import: no #271 device proof is part of this set.
